label: SQL (customers and orders)
description: Read rows from a relational table: in mock mode from a stdlib SQLite database seeded from this node's own seed file, with no credentials and no server; in live mode from Postgres. The step binds the upstream node's value to the query's named placeholder.

spec.query: SELECT o.id, o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = :input ORDER BY o.id
spec.seed_sql:
-- Example data for the mock database: three customers and three of their orders.
-- Both this seed and the query above are examples; replace them via the Inspector.
-- The seed runs once, before the read-only guard is armed, so it may contain DDL.
CREATE TABLE customers (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
    total REAL NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city) VALUES
    (1, 'Acme Corp', 'Berlin'),
    (2, 'Globex', 'Lisbon'),
    (3, 'Initech', 'Austin');

INSERT INTO orders (id, customer_id, total) VALUES
    (1, 1, 120.50),
    (2, 1, 80.00),
    (3, 2, 42.75);
